info.title: Enlace Group Loan API
info.description:
API for group lending: onboarding, loans, repayments, trust and credibility.

Documentation layout: **Admin** and **Users** are top-level groups in the sidebar when your viewer supports `x-tagGroups` (e.g. Redoc, Stoplight). Sub-bullets (Dashboard, KYC, …) are OpenAPI tags. **Note:** borrower KYC lives under `/auth/kyc`, `/auth/nin`, `/auth/lookup` (shown as **Users · KYC**). Swagger UI often lists tags flat and alphabetically.

tags.name: Admin · Dashboard
tags.description: Admin home: KPI dashboard (`GET /admin/dashboard`) and cross-entity search (`GET /admin/search`). Requires admin JWT when ADMIN_EMAILS is set.

tags.name: Admin · KYC
tags.description: Admin KYC: counts, list, detail, approve/reject, Mono verify/statement (`/admin/kyc/...`).

tags.name: Admin · Users & groups
tags.description: Admin credit groups and users: summaries, list, export, create group, detail, patch (`/admin/groups/...`, `/admin/users/...`).

tags.name: Admin · Loan operations
tags.description: Admin loan desk: operations dashboard KPIs and tabbed lists (`/admin/loan-operations/...`), loan request queue (`/admin/loan-requests`), workflow status and disburse (`/admin/loans/{id}/status`, `POST /admin/loans/{id}/disburse`).

tags.name: Users · Auth
tags.description: Account lifecycle: signup, login, profile, passwords, invitations, income, loan PIN (`/auth/...` except KYC/NIN/lookup routes).

tags.name: Users · Loans
tags.description: Loan requests, get loan, member approve/reject, individual activity feed, and individual direct-debit mandate setup (`/loans/...` except institutional callback).

201.description: Created. A verification email was sent; user must verify email before logging in.

message.description: e.g. Please verify your email. Check your inbox for the verification link.

post.description: Verifies the user's email using the token sent in the welcome email. The frontend verify-email page (e.g. opened from the link in the email) should read the token from the URL and send it in the request body.

token.description: Verification token from the welcome email

200.description: On first successful verification, body is **identical** to `POST /auth/login` 200: `token`, `user` (sanitized), `onboardingState`. If the email was already verified (e.g. link opened twice), returns `success: false` and `message` with HTTP 200.

400.description: Invalid or expired verification link

get.description: Returns the full user object. Includes two computed fields: `userType` (`"group"` or `"individual"`, derived from active group membership) and `individualDirectDebitActive` (boolean, only present when `userType` is `"individual"`). Group members also get `groups[].group.runningMandate` to indicate active direct-debit mandate status per group.

patch.description: Partial update of `fullName`, `phone`, `location`, and/or `employmentStatus`. Send at least one field. Empty strings clear nullable fields. To change monthly income and individual credit limit, use `POST /auth/income`.

400.description: Validation error or no fields to update

post.description: Sends a password reset email if an account exists. Always returns the same message for security.

message.description: If an account exists with this email, we sent a password reset link.

post.summary: Set new password with reset token
post.description: Set a new password using the token from the forget-password email link.

token.description: Reset token from the email link

200.description: Password reset. User can now sign in.

400.description: Invalid or expired reset link

post.description: Change password for the current user. Requires current password.

get.description: Returns invitation details for the link baseUrl/member-invitation/{token}. Use to show the invite page (group name, inviter). type 'signup' = not yet registered; type 'invited' = existing user, must sign in to accept.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Short invitation token from the email link

fullName.description: Only for type signup: name from the invite

phone.description: Only for type signup: phone from the invite if any

post.description: Accept the group invitation. For type 'signup': send signup in body (email must match invite); account is created and verify-email is sent. For type 'invited': send Authorization header (logged-in user must be the invitee).

signup.description: Required when invitation type is signup (new user). Email must match the invited email.

400.description: Email must match invite, or signup required, or validation error

401.description: Sign in required to accept (for type invited)

403.description: Invitation was sent to a different account

409.description: Email already has an account; sign in and accept from there

403.description: Email not verified; user must verify email before signing in

post.summary: Submit income (and employment). Recomputes credit limit and group pools.
Set loan PIN once (4 digits). Cannot be set again after it is set.

409.description: Loan PIN has already been set and cannot be changed

post.description: Looks up NIN, sends OTP to phone on NIN record, and stores pending verification server-side.

400.description: NIN lookup failed or invalid data

post.description: Verifies OTP for submitted NIN and saves ninData in user_kyc_data.

400.description: Invalid OTP, expired OTP, or mismatched NIN

get.description: Returns list of banks (Mono lookup/banks). Use nip_code or bank_code when verifying account.

400.description: Bank list lookup failed

post.description: Looks up account name and bank details for the given account number and bank code (Mono lookup/account-number).

400.description: Account lookup failed or invalid request

get.summary: Get KYC status and current step

comment.description: Admin comment (e.g. what to update) when KYC is flagged or under review

put.summary: Submit current KYC step (advances to next step)
put.description: NIN verification is separate under /auth/nin. KYC now has 3 steps: 0 (nin+fullName+address), 1 (account+bvn+code), 2 (employmentDetails).

step.description: Submit verified NIN, set full name, and save address

nin.description: Must match previously verified NIN from /auth/nin/verify

step.description: Submit account details, BVN, and statement code

accountName.description: Must match user fullName or request is rejected

code.description: Code used to fetch bank statement

400.description: Wrong step or validation error

post.summary: Go back to a previous KYC step

400.description: Cannot go back (e.g. already submitted or toStep invalid)

get.description: Returns the full dashboard for the authenticated user. `userType` is `"group"` if the user is an active member of a group, or `"individual"` for standalone users. The `view` field is `"onboarding"` until the user (or all group members) complete KYC; then `"full"`. Fields marked as group-only are null for individuals; fields marked individual-only are null for group members.
Returns KPIs (portfolio value, active loans, default rate, pending KYC), portfolio growth by week, system alerts, recent loan operations, and distribution by loan type.
Search across users (by fullName or email), loans (by id or amount), and repayments/transactions (by id or loanId).
Total groups, sum of credit limit proxy (COALESCE(maximumAmount, targetCredit)) for ACTIVE groups, and count of groups with derived onboarding status PENDING_KYC.
Same filters as list; returns up to `limit` rows (default 5000) as JSON with Content-Disposition attachment.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search name, group id, display groupId, or initiator

get.description: Paginated directory with initiator, member count, credit limit fields, and derived onboardingStatus for the admin Credit Groups table.

post.description: Same payload as `POST /groups` plus `createdByUserId` (existing user who becomes creator). Sends invites when `members` provided.

400.description: Validation or business rule

get.description: Members with KYC UI status, bank statement flag, and trust score. CREATOR listed first.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Filter by member name or email

get.description: Merges six event types — repayments, loan requests, loan approvals, loan disbursements, member joins, and member exits — sorted newest-first and capped at `limit`. All event types share the same shape; `amount` and `loanId` are null for membership events.
Placeholder until PDF/certificate generation exists.
Group profile (without embedded members list), onboarding status, financial health, tier/eligibility flags, metadata, and insight note for the admin group detail page.

patch.description: Partial update for group credit configuration and risk controls. Supports target credit, credibility (score/level), loan limits, repayment config, interest/penalty config, and credit freeze toggle.

creditFrozen.description: When true, new group loan requests are rejected

400.description: Validation

get.description: Search by name, email, or user id. Optional kycStatus and creditStatus filters. Includes active group membership when present.
Profile and memberships; excludes password and sensitive tokens.

Cards: total ACTIVE loans, sum of amounts in APPROVED/REVIEWING/PROCESSING (pending disbursement), repayment rate (PAID / all installments), portfolio value (disbursed lifecycle loans). Change percentages are placeholders (0) until trend data exists.

`tab`: pending (REQUESTED, PENDING_APPROVAL, INSTITUTIONAL_PENDING — not yet fully approved), pending_disbursement (APPROVED/REVIEWING/PROCESSING), active (ACTIVE), repayment_schedule (ACTIVE + installments), declined (REJECTED). Search matches borrower name/email, group name, or loan UUID. `disbursementReadiness` and `canDisburse` apply to pending_disbursement group loans; `canDisburse` requires borrower loan PIN.

400.description: Validation (e.g. missing tab)

post.description: Same as PATCH `/admin/loans/{id}/status` with DISBURSED: group loan only, mandates enforced in service. Requires borrower to have set a loan PIN (`canDisburse` on list).

200.description: Loan disbursed and moved to ACTIVE

400.description: PIN missing, wrong status, or mandate rules

get.description: Paginated list of all loans. Optional filters: `status` (comma-separated LoanStatus), `dateFrom` and `dateTo` (ISO date, filters by createdAt). If `ADMIN_EMAILS` is set, the JWT user email must be in that list.

patch.summary: Set group loan admin workflow status
patch.description: APPROVED from REQUESTED, PENDING_APPROVAL, or INSTITUTIONAL_PENDING (admin override: resolves pending peer approvals). REVIEWING from APPROVED; PROCESSING from APPROVED or REVIEWING; DISBURSED runs disbursement (credit pool, repayment schedule, ACTIVE). Group loans only.

400.description: Invalid transition or not a group loan

get.description: Count user_kyc_data rows. Omit query params to count all. Optional `status` filters by users.kycStatus (User table). Optional `search` by user fullName or email.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by users.kycStatus (PENDING, SUBMITTED, RESUBMITTED, FLAGGED, APPROVED, REJECTED)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by user fullName or email

get.description: Returns user_kyc_data–backed rows when no filters. Optional `status` filters by users.kycStatus. Optional `search` by user fullName or email. **Group aggregation:** users who are active group members appear once per group (one row per group, `type` Group, `is_group` true); others appear as Individual rows. `count` is total matching KYC rows before group collapse, not the length of `items`.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by users.kycStatus; omit to return all KYC records

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by user fullName or email

get.description: Returns direct debit mandates still in setup/rework states (INACTIVE, INPROGRESS, FAILED, CANCELED). Supports filtering by mandate type and search by user/group.
Returns direct debit mandates with COMPLETED status waiting for admin review and approval/revert action.

post.summary: Approve or revert a completed mandate
post.description: Admin review action for COMPLETED mandates. `approve` moves status to APPROVED. `revert` moves status to INACTIVE and requires comment.

400.description: Invalid action payload or mandate not COMPLETED

get.description: Returns the credit group header plus one list item per member (active or invited), each item matching the same shape as GET /admin/kyc individual rows (`AdminKycListItem`). Use `kycId` from an item with GET /admin/kyc/{kycId} for full payload when present.
Get full KYC details by kycId. BVN value is not returned; only a bvnProvided flag. A user can have multiple KYC records.

post.description: Approve KYC by kycId. Sets KYC record status to APPROVED, verification flags, and user kycStatus to APPROVED. Use kycId (not userId) because a user can have multiple KYC records. Optional `creditLimit` updates `users.creditLimit` only for **individual** borrowers (no active group membership); it is ignored for active group members.

creditLimit.description: When set, updates the user's credit limit on approve (individuals only)

400.description: Invalid creditLimit, KYC already approved, or cannot approve rejected KYC

post.description: Reject KYC by kycId. Optionally send comment in body for the user.

400.description: Cannot reject approved KYC

post.description: Verify address via third-party (Mono). Updates kyc_verifications.addressApproved.
Verify credit history via third-party (Mono v3 BVN lookup). Updates kyc_verifications.creditHistoryApproved. If already verified, skips the API call to avoid cost. Requires BVN on the KYC record.

400.description: No BVN on KYC record or BVN decryption failed

get.description: If statement exists in DB for this KYC's user, return it. Otherwise fetch via third-party (Mono), save to DB, and return.

400.description: No linked account to fetch statement

post.description: Verify NIN via third-party (Mono lookup). Updates kyc_verifications.ninApproved.

400.description: No NIN on KYC record

post.description: Creates a group with the caller as creator. Optionally include `members` to add members and send them invite emails (existing users get a group_member invite; new users get a pending group_invite until they sign up).

members.description: Optional list of members to add and send invite emails. Existing users are added as invited members; new users get a pending invite until signup.

400.description: Validation error or invitee already in a group / already invited

post.summary: Poke pending email invite (creator only, once)
post.description: Resends the group invitation email for a **pending** row in `group_invites` (invitee has not signed up yet). Only the group **creator** may call this. Each invite can only be poked **once** (`poke` on the row becomes true). Does not apply to registered users invited via `group_members` (use other flows).

200.description: Reminder email queued; invite row returned with `poke` true

400.description: Invite no longer pending, or reminder was already sent

403.description: Only the group creator can poke

400.description: Already exited or exit already requested

post.summary: Permanent exit (only when all group loans repaid)

400.description: Cannot exit until group loans repaid

get.summary: Get my direct debit mandate for a group
get.description: Returns the current user's direct debit mandate for the group, if any. Required to be an active group member.

403.description: Not an active member of this group

post.summary: Create mandate (if needed) and send BVN OTP
post.description: Ensures a direct debit mandate exists for the user and group (creates INACTIVE if none), then initiates Mono BVN verification and sends OTP to phone or email. Use mandate.id with the confirm endpoint. Optional body: { "resend": true } to count as resend (throttled once per 3 hours).

200.description: OTP sent; mandate returned for confirm step

400.description: Already have an active mandate, KYC/BVN missing, BVN init or OTP failed, mandate not INACTIVE, or resend throttled

403.description: Not an active member of this group

get.summary: List saved direct-debit accounts for this group
get.description: Returns bank accounts linked for the current user under the group's current lending mandate period (same shape as confirm response accounts), ordered by createdAt descending. Empty array unless the user's latest direct-debit mandate for this group is INPROGRESS, COMPLETED, APPROVED, or ACTIVE (BVN/accounts flow completed). Also empty if there is no current group mandate period, no member mandate, or no accounts saved. Requires active group membership.

403.description: Not an active member of this group

post.summary: Confirm mandate with OTP and link accounts
post.description: Verify OTP with Mono, fetch BVN-linked bank accounts, create a Mono payment mandate per account and save Account records, then set the direct debit mandate INPROGRESS. After account mandate verification, call `.../done` to mark the setup COMPLETED for admin review. Response includes all successfully saved linked accounts (use account ids for refresh/verify). mandateId comes from POST /groups/{groupId}/direct-debit-mandate response. Mandate debit cap is derived server-side from the group (max of currentCreditPool and targetCredit; default 1,000,000 NGN if both are zero). Body: otp only.

accounts.description: All bank accounts successfully linked in this confirm call

400.description: Mandate not pending, authorize first, invalid OTP, no BVN accounts, no accounts could be linked via Mono, or Mono customer/create failed

post.summary: Mark group mandate setup as done
post.description: Customer confirms setup completion after account linking/verification. Moves direct debit mandate from INPROGRESS to COMPLETED for admin review.

400.description: Mandate not in progress or wrong flow

post.summary: Get or refresh Mono payment mandate for a linked account
post.description: Returns the debit account if status is ACTIVE, or if a mandate reference exists and was created less than 3 hours ago. Otherwise calls Mono POST /v3/payments/mandates (same shape as confirm flow), updates reference and initiateMandateData, and resets the account createdAt window. Account must belong to the group and the current user. accountId is returned from confirm (saved Account id).

400.description: Mono initiate failed or account missing bank link

403.description: Not your account or wrong group

post.summary: Verify direct debit mandate status with Mono
post.description: GET Mono v3/payments/mandates/{reference} using the account reference. If approved, sets the account status to ACTIVE. Returns 400 while mandate is still pending approval.

400.description: Mandate pending approval or no reference

403.description: Not your account or wrong group

get.description: Returns loans where the authenticated user is the borrower and the loan is not tied to a group (`groupId` is null). Newest first.

post.description: Create an individual (non-group) loan for the authenticated user. Amount must not exceed the user's credit limit AND the remaining access amount for the current individual mandate period (40% of annual income, rolling 12-month window). The mandate period is created automatically on first request. Requires onboarding complete and loan PIN in body.

400.description: Amount exceeds credit limit or individual mandate access amount for the current period

403.description: Onboarding not complete or invalid PIN

post.description: Create a group loan; all active group members must approve. Each approver must have an active or admin-approved direct debit mandate for the group (within the last 12 months); if not, they must create and authorize a mandate before approving. The loan tenor is validated: the last repayment date (from today + tenorMonths) must fall on or before the current group mandate end date, or the request fails (renew mandate or reduce tenor). Requires onboarding complete and loan PIN in body.

400.description: Amount exceeds pool/access, KYC incomplete, tenor extends beyond group mandate end date, or no active members

post.description: Returns loans for the authenticated user's active group(s). Filters are passed in request body: `status` (multiple values), `startDate`, `endDate`, and `myLoan`. When `myLoan` is true, only loans created by the authenticated user are returned.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's own loan requests and paid repayments, merged and sorted newest-first. Intended for individual (non-group) users; group members should use the group activity endpoint. Capped at 50 items.
Returns the current user's individual (non-group) direct-debit mandate, if any. Returns `{ mandate: null }` if none exists yet.

post.summary: Create individual mandate and send BVN OTP
post.description: Creates an individual (non-group) direct-debit mandate if one does not already exist (or the existing one is no longer active), then initiates Mono BVN verification and sends OTP to the user's phone or email. Use the returned `mandate.id` with the confirm endpoint. Optional body: `{ "resend": true }` (throttled once per 3 hours).

200.description: OTP sent; mandate returned for confirm step

400.description: Already have an active mandate within 12 months, BVN/KYC missing, Mono BVN init or OTP failed, or resend throttled

get.description: Returns the bank accounts linked for the current user under their active individual mandate period, ordered by createdAt descending. Empty array if no mandate exists or the mandate has not reached INPROGRESS, COMPLETED, APPROVED, or ACTIVE state yet.

post.description: Verifies the BVN OTP, fetches BVN-linked bank accounts from Mono, creates a Mono payment mandate for each account, saves Account rows linked to the user's active individual UserMandate, and marks the DirectDebitMandate as INPROGRESS. Returns the updated mandate and created accounts.

400.description: Invalid OTP, mandate not INACTIVE, no session ID, BVN/KYC missing, no accounts returned, or this is a group mandate

post.summary: Mark individual mandate setup as done
post.description: Customer confirms individual mandate setup completion. Moves direct debit mandate from INPROGRESS to COMPLETED for admin review.

400.description: Mandate not in progress or wrong flow

post.summary: Get or refresh individual account Mono mandate
post.description: Returns the linked bank account as-is if the Mono mandate reference is fresh (< 3 hours) or the account is already ACTIVE. Otherwise re-initiates a Mono payment mandate and persists the new reference. Use this to ensure the mandate reference is current before the bank authorises it.

400.description: Missing bank details; complete confirmation first

403.description: Account not linked to your individual mandate

post.summary: Poll Mono to verify individual account mandate approval
post.description: Calls the Mono payment mandate retrieval API to check whether the bank has approved the mandate. Marks the account ACTIVE if approved. Returns 400 with `data: null` if still pending.

400.description: Mandate still pending or no mandate reference

403.description: Account not linked to your individual mandate

get.description: Return loan details. Allowed for the borrower or for a group member who is an approver for this loan.

post.description: Record the caller's approval for a group loan. Only active group members can approve. For group loans, the approver must have an active or admin-approved direct debit mandate for the group (created and authorized within the last 12 months). If the approver has no running mandate, they must create and authorize direct debit on their account(s) before they can approve. Requires onboarding complete and request body with loanPin (4 digits). When all members have approved, the loan moves to APPROVED and is disbursed.

400.description: Loan not pending approval, already has a rejection, or approver must have an active direct debit mandate for this group (start mandate OTP flow then confirm first)

403.description: Not an active group member, not eligible to approve this loan, or invalid loan PIN

post.summary: Partner callback: continue after institutional approval
post.description: Called by partner/lender when an institutional group loan is approved. Moves loan from INSTITUTIONAL_PENDING to PENDING_APPROVAL and creates pending approval records for group members.

400.description: Loan not INSTITUTIONAL_PENDING

post.description: Record the caller's rejection for a group loan. Only active group members can reject. Requires onboarding complete and loan PIN in body. Once any member rejects, the loan status becomes REJECTED.

400.description: Loan not pending approval or caller already responded

403.description: Not an active group member or invalid loan PIN

400.description: Invalid amount or loan not repayable

bearerAuth.description: JWT from login, verify-email (first success), or signup flows that return a token

AuthLoginSuccess.description: Returned by POST /auth/login on success and by POST /auth/verify-email on first successful email verification (same contract).

user.description: Sanitized user (no secrets); `pin` is boolean loan-PIN set flag

onboardingState.description: INCOME_PENDING until monthly income is submitted; then ONBOARDING_COMPLETE

success.description: Always false when email was already verified

VerifyEmailAlready.description: Returned when the account was already verified (e.g. verification link opened again).

kycId.description: Primary key of user_kyc_data. May be empty string when a member has no KYC row yet (group drill-down only).

kycIdDisplay.description: Human-readable id e.g. KYC-77210, or an em dash when kycId is empty

type.description: Individual = person-level row; Group = collapsed row representing the whole credit group (list only)

is_group.description: True when this list row is the single aggregated row for a group; false for a person

group.description: Set when type is Group; null for individuals

documentStatus.description: Human-readable document / verification line items for the admin queue

members.description: Same item shape as GET /admin/kyc (individual-style rows per member)

creditLimitUpdated.description: Present only when the request included `creditLimit`. True if users.creditLimit was updated (individual borrower); false if the user is an active group member (limit ignored).

pin.description: True if the user has set a loan PIN, false otherwise

userType.description: Derived on GET /auth/profile. 'group' = active member of a credit group; 'individual' = standalone user. Computed from current group_members state — never stale.

individualDirectDebitActive.description: Only present on GET /auth/profile when userType is 'individual'. True if the user's individual DirectDebitMandate is ACTIVE or APPROVED.

runningMandate.description: On profile nested group: true if this user has an ACTIVE direct-debit mandate for this group within the last 12 months

group.description: Nested group details; includes runningMandate on GET /auth/profile

GroupInvite.description: Pending email invitation to join a group (invitee not registered yet). `poke` is false until the creator uses POST .../poke once.

poke.description: True after the one-time resend was used

DebitLinkedAccount.description: Bank account linked for group-year direct debit (accounts table)

DirectDebitMandateResult.description: Serialised DirectDebitMandate returned by mandate endpoints.

UserMandate.description: Individual (non-group) yearly lending mandate period. Tracks the rolling 12-month access cap for a standalone user.

year.description: Period-start encoded as YYYYMMDD integer (same convention as group Mandate).

totalAccessAmount.description: 40% of user's annual income — the cap for this mandate period.

IndividualMandateInfo.description: Summary of the active individual mandate period shown on the dashboard.

IndividualOnboarding.description: Onboarding checklist for a standalone (non-group) user.

directDebitSetup.description: True if the user's individual DirectDebitMandate is ACTIVE or APPROVED.

UserActivityItem.description: Single item in the individual user activity feed.

GroupActivityItem.description: Single item in the admin group activity feed.

DashboardData.description: Unified dashboard response for both group members and individual users.

view.description: onboarding = KYC not yet complete; full = ready to transact.

userType.description: group = active member of a credit group; individual = standalone user.

groupHealthPercent.description: Group members: % of members with KYC+income+bank done. Individual: 100 if KYC approved, proportional otherwise.

groupOnboarding.description: Group member onboarding checklist. Null for individual users.

individualOnboarding.description: Individual user onboarding checklist. Null for group members.

personalLimit.description: User's individual credit limit (3× monthly income).

projectedGroupLimit.description: Group target credit (0 for individual users).

trustBadge.description: Display label for the user's trust level badge.

groupPoolStatus.description: One entry per group the user is active in (empty for individual users).

credibilityScore.description: Highest credibility score across user's groups. Null for individual users.

deadline.description: Group quarterly end date. Null for individual users.

nonAcceptedMemberships.description: Group invitees who have not yet accepted. Empty for individual users.

userId.description: Set when invitee has an account (group_members); null for email-only group_invites

inviteId.description: Present for pending email-only invites (group_invites id); use with POST /groups/{id}/invites/{inviteId}/poke

poke.description: Only on email-only invites: true if the creator already used the one-time poke

individualMandate.description: Active individual mandate period info. Null for group members.

memberCount.description: Number of active members in the loan's group.

approvedMemberCount.description: Number of group members that already approved this loan.

mandateId.description: Group mandate FK — set for group loans.

userMandateId.description: Individual mandate FK — set for individual (non-group) loans.
